description: This file implements the login page component for a web application, including UI elements, state management, authentication logic, and integration with API calls to fetch organizational data and handle user login.

methods.name: handleFindOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching of user organizations by email, updates state with organization data or errors, and auto-selects 'Kavia B2C' if available.

methods.name: handleOrganizationSelect
methods.description: Updates selected organization ID based on user selection and logs selected information.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Authenticates user using selected organization, email, and password, handles success by navigating to dashboard, and manages error states.
